displayTitle: The Blacksmith They Dared Not Let into Hell
description: The blacksmith has sold himself to the Devil for seven years as master of all masters, and he has painted it over his door. Then Our Lord drops in, shoes a horse by taking its legs off as easily as you’d pull off a mitten, and grants the blacksmith three wishes.
summary: A blacksmith with three cunning wishes traps the Devil, only to discover neither Hell nor Heaven is eager to admit him.
